summary: The court hearing discusses a case involving Nimbus Apollo versus US Bank National Association. Mr. Rubye, representing the appellant, argues that the clerk prematurely issued a certificate of title in a foreclosure case, thereby bypassing a required 10-day objection period and subsequent hearing. He explains that several motions for rehearing and to vacate were filed but were denied without a hearing, which he contends goes against established case law that requires a hearing for such objections. The judge questions what actions were taken to ensure a hearing was set.
